claims: Two independently authenticated humans joined the isolated room through invitations
Unaddressed human question reached both agents as optional notices; each independently contributed in both human browsers
Targeted request remained request for Atlas and optional notice for Nova; Atlas's recipient-free question reached Nova once, produced her own answer, and did not wake Atlas itself
Both browsers observed naturally authored public stream growth; incomplete chunks scheduled nobody and final commit scheduled exactly one peer notice
Both agents processed an unaddressed closing notice without public posts and the whole room became quiescent
